falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom was followed by a sustained recovery with lower highs; a break above 5,600 would indicate this is not a comparable bottoming structure but rather a V-shaped recovery or false breakdown, making the HOLD signal incorrect

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for two consecutive days within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 suggests elevated fear/uncertainty typical of capitulation; a VIX sustained below 14 would indicate fear has fully evaporated and the market has already bottomed and normalized, proving the current bottom call was too late or wrong

falsification_conditions.condition: 10-Year Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rapid flight-to-quality bid in bonds this deep would signal a deflationary or recessionary panic rather than the inflationary/stagflationary bottom pattern of August 2024, invalidating the pattern match and suggesting the macro regime has shifted to a different outcome than the one being positioned for

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
